title: Email to staff: Jensen Huang admits an affair, takes "full responsibility", and says he fell short of his duties to Nvidia's board, shareholders, and employees (Madison Mills/Axios)
summary: Madison Mills / Axios: Email to staff: Jensen Huang admits an affair, takes “full responsibility”, and says he fell short of his duties to Nvidia's board, shareholders, and employees — Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to having a romantic relationship with a suspected Chinese spy in a message to his company.
